description: Adds a buyer question to a topic so it is asked on every engine in the plan from the next run. Counts toward the plan's question limit. Calling again with the same text returns the existing question, never a duplicate.

confirm_new_engines.description: Set true to confirm using an engine this workspace has never used before.

target_engines.description: Optional: limit to these engines. Omit for the plan's engines.

text.description: The question, phrased the way a buyer would ask an AI assistant.

name: create_prompt
title: Track a new buyer question
